description: This file defines a Web API controller named UserController for handling user authentication and information retrieval in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes methods for getting the current user info, logging out, and creating a UserInfo object based on claims.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: ASP.NET Core API controller managing user-related actions such as retrieving current user information and logging out.

methods.name: GetCurrentUser
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current authenticated user's information.

methods.name: Logout
methods.description: Handles POST requests to log out the current user, clear cache, and sign out authentication cookies.

methods.name: CreateUserInfo
methods.description: Constructs a UserInfo object based on claims in the ClaimsPrincipal.
